Title: Question on Allies that "play X as a vampire with a capacity of Y"

Messages.Author: JJeff
Messages.Body:
I have a sinple question:

Allies that can "play X as a vampire with a capacity of Y" and have a
printed life amount LESS that "Y", why do they have the ability to
play as a "vampire of capacity Y"?

Shouldn't the capacity be the Life maximum?

Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:


An ally doesn't have a life maximum. They have a starting amount
of life. If an event would add life to an ally then all life
gained remain on that ally, in difference from a vampire where
excess blood goes back to the blood bank.

Sten During
